title: Reports
noReports: When someone reports something, it shows up here.
alreadyDeleted: This content has already been removed.
reportReasonPlaceholder: For example: it’s spam, or it’s hurtful.
deleteWithPlaceholder: Delete and leave "Deleted by a moderator"
confirmDeleteContent: Delete this content, or delete it and leave a placeholder in its place?
viewingAs: Viewing as {name} — you can browse and delete content, but not post or change anything.
reportThanks: Thanks. A moderator will look at it.
reportDescription: Moderators see what you report and who reported it. The person you report doesn’t.
lede: What people reported, newest first. The person reported never sees who reported them.
deleteBody: It goes for good, and the report is closed.
